title: Welcome to Folloze Insights
body_html:
Folloze Insights is the lightweight publishing layer for the first version of the content engine. The goal is simple: publish clean, reviewable thought leadership pages on a fast Vercel site before the handoff to a broader Webflow workflow in v2.

This v1 setup keeps the stack intentionally narrow. Gemini powers generation, release artifacts are promoted manually, and every page is easy to inspect, verify, and transfer to the web team later.

What this test proves

It proves the end-to-end path from content artifact to public-facing page. It also gives the marketing and web teams a concrete deploy target, a simple page model, and a small surface area to operate while the automation matures.

What comes next

Next, the pipeline will promote real generated posts into this blog, verify preview and production routes, and leave behind the logs and docs needed for a clean handoff.
meta_description: A simple V1 Folloze blog on Vercel used to validate the content engine delivery path.
